title: Hornwort RNA Extraction Protocol
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p28dqhw

steps.title: Grind tissue and transfer
steps.instruction: Grind 0.5–2 g of hornwort tissue in a mortar and pestle with liquid nitrogen until finely ground. Transfer the frozen ground tissue to a 30 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Make 25 mL of extraction buffer containing 100 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8 (using a 2 M stock).

steps.title: Add buffer and PVP, incubate
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of 60 °C extraction buffer and 100 mg PVP‑40 per gram of tissue to the tube. Mix by inversion and incubate at 60 °C in a water bath for 30 min (or on ice for 15 min).

steps.title: Cool to room temperature
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from heat and allow it to cool to room temperature for 4–6 min.

steps.title: Add chloroform‑IAA and emulsify
steps.instruction: Add 12 mL of chloroform:IAA (24:1) to the tube and mix by inversion until a uniform emulsion forms.

steps.title: Centrifuge first extraction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA with NaCl and ethanol
steps.instruction: To the recovered aqueous phase, add 0.5 × volume of 5 M NaCl and mix well. Then add 2 × volume of cold (‑20 °C) 95 % ethanol, invert to mix, place the tube in a ‑20 °C freezer for 10 min, and centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 6 min.

steps.title: Optional repeat precipitation
steps.instruction: If desired, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL TE buffer and repeat the precipitation steps described in the previous step.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, wash the RNA pellet with cold (0–4 °C) 70 % (v/v) ethanol, and air‑dry the pellet.

steps.title: Dissolve in TE and add LiCl
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried pellet in 400 µL TE buffer, add 100 µL of 8 M LiCl, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pellet RNA and remove DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 min (speed as previously used) to pellet RNA, then carefully remove the supernatant, which contains DNA.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA with NaOAc and ethanol
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA pellet in 400 µL DEPC‑treated water, add 40 µL sodium acetate (pH 4.5), add 1 mL 95 % ethanol, and freeze at ‑80 °C for 10 min (optional: wash pellet with 95 % ethanol).

steps.title: Spin and resuspend in DEPC water
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 min, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 40 µL DEPC‑treated water.

steps.title: Optional solubilization if pellet remains insoluble
steps.instruction: If the pellet does not dissolve, incubate at 60 °C for 10 min, then place on ice for 30 min. Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm for 10 min and transfer the clear supernatant (RNA) to a new tube.
